The video shows Sasa Yoruzaki, an artist with an overwhelming sense of fashion and singing ability, despite her cool and slightly cheeky responses. Later, when he goes to an old laundromat to deal with some laundry problems, he suddenly notices a woman and feels something is off about her. The woman seems familiar, but it is Sasa herself, the one he had just seen in the video.

title: Boukansha no Koi
titleNative: 傍観者の恋
synopsis: "I want to be by her side until the very last moment..." In the autumn of her twentieth year, Rachel marries her childhood friend Noah, her long-time crush. Even though she knows that the person Noah truly loved is his sister and Rachel's best friend, Alicia... Bright and beautiful Alicia was born with a heart condition, and her remaining time is limited. Rachel's marriage with Noah is built on on a lie, just to allow them to stay close to Alicia in what little time she had left. Rachel has moments of incredible happiness, but also feels guilt and heartache at the same time. However, before she knew it, she begins to notice Noah's passionate gaze looking her way… Who is the real "bystander" in this love triangle? The long-awaited manga adaptation of a heart-wrenching story of unrequited love, irreplaceable friendship, and mutual misunderstandings! (Source: J-Publishing, translated) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito!
